macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street edges higher as oil prices retreat
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.54% to 50,279.17, the S&P 500 gained 0.31% to 7,455.85, and the Nasdaq advanced 0.34% to 26,360.76. Falling Treasury yields and lower oil prices, alongside optimism about a potential U.S.-Iran agreement, supported risk appetite.[1]

items.title: U.S. jobless claims decline
items.summary: Initial U.S. unemployment claims fell to 209,000, slightly below expectations, suggesting continued labor-market resilience and giving the Federal Reserve room to maintain its policy stance while monitoring inflation.[1]

items.title: Fed minutes point to another possible rate hike
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s latest meeting showed that most officials expected another interest-rate increase would likely be needed this year because inflation remained elevated and progress toward the 2% target had stalled.[5]

items.title: Richmond Fed president says higher Treasury yields do not signal rising fiscal concerns
items.summary: Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin said the recent increase in Treasury yields did not indicate growing concern about inflation or widening government fiscal deficits.[1]

items.title: Nvidia earnings beat expectations but provide limited market lift
items.summary: Nvidia reported earnings above expectations, but the results failed to generate strong optimism in futures trading, as investors remained focused on broader technology-sector valuations and interest rates.[1]

items.title: Paramount completes $81 billion Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
items.summary: Skydance-owned Paramount closed its $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a new Hollywood company that will operate under the Skydance name.[5]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ether fall as $609 million in crypto positions are liquidated
items.summary: Bitcoin fell as much as 2.5% to $83,470, while Ether dropped 4.9% to $2,567. Forced selling liquidated roughly $609 million in crypto positions over 24 hours, with XRP and Solana also declining.

items.title: U.S.-linked wallets move about $103 million in Bitcoin and BNB
items.summary: Wallets linked to the U.S. government transferred approximately 833.6 BTC and 40,285 BNB, with the Bitcoin moved to Coinbase Prime addresses as Bitcoin tested the $83,000–$84,000 range.

items.title: Winklevoss firm files for spot Zcash ETF
items.summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed a preliminary SEC registration for a spot Zcash fund. The filing disclosed a previously reported flaw in Zcash’s Orchard privacy pool; developers said it was fixed and found no evidence of exploitation.

items.title: CFTC requires Kalshi to continue operating in New York
items.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission reportedly required prediction-market operator Kalshi to continue operating in New York despite litigation brought by the state attorney general.

items.title: Coinbase completes Deribit integration and plans broader derivatives platform
items.summary: Coinbase said it completed its integration of options exchange Deribit, acquired for about $2.9 billion, creating Coinbase Global Exchange. The company also plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro with spot, futures, perpetuals, options and stocks.

items.title: OKX raises funding at a $25 billion valuation and launches stablecoin app
items.summary: OKX said Circle, Ripple, Standard Chartered’s SC Ventures and Qube Research & Technologies joined its funding round at a $25 billion pre-money valuation. The exchange also launched OKX Money, a stablecoin savings and payments application targeting emerging markets.

items.title: Arbitrum DAO considers additional 100 million ARB allocation for USDG
items.summary: An Arbitrum DAO proposal would provide an additional 100 million ARB to support the USDG stablecoin initiative, alongside plans involving fee conversion and treasury-asset management.

items.title: Orca token rises about 12% in 24 hours
items.summary: Orca gained approximately 12% to reach $2.84, while spot trading volume roughly doubled to $384 million, according to market reports.

items.title: Ethereum Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia testnet
items.summary: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade, including enshrined proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and gas repricing, went live on the Sepolia testnet. Mainnet timing has not been decided.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, a smaller model for classification, summarization, extraction, support, voice agents and in-app assistants. The company says it costs 75% less than Haiku 4.5 and adds safeguards for certain high-risk cybersecurity requests.[1]

items.title: Mistral previews one-trillion-parameter Large 4 model
items.summary: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a natively multimodal model with one trillion total parameters and 49 billion active parameters. The company is targeting coding, agentic workflows, cybersecurity, finance, legal work and visual understanding, with full weights expected later in October.[2]

items.title: OpenAI reports hundreds of AI-generated mathematical discoveries
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly published 722 AI-generated mathematical discoveries, reflecting progress from an internal frontier reasoning model on previously unsolved problems and advanced mathematical topics.[3]

items.title: Nvidia introduces Open Agent Safety Platform
items.summary: Nvidia launched an open platform combining OpenShell and Sentry to monitor and contain AI agents. The company says the system can quarantine agents that attempt to exceed their boundaries within milliseconds.[4]

items.title: Liquid AI releases speculative-decoding drafter model
items.summary: Liquid AI released an experimental drafter model for LFM2.5-VL-3B that is designed to accelerate inference without changing outputs. The company reports speed gains of up to 3.13 times on-device and 2.66 times on an H100 GPU.[4]

items.title: OpenAI expands Codex cloud development environments
items.summary: OpenAI announced reusable cloud development environments for Codex that can be accessed across devices, alongside voice controls, code review, security tools and new APIs.[4]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day launches on Xbox and PC
items.summary: Microsoft announced the full release of Gears of War: E-Day, now available on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Xbox Game Pass Ultimate.

items.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 begins October 13
items.summary: Electronic Arts announced that Battlefield 6’s fifth content season will start on October 13 and released a new gameplay trailer.

items.title: ARC Raiders and The Finals adaptations announced
items.summary: Chernin Entertainment is reportedly adapting Embark Studios’ games ARC Raiders and The Finals for television and film.

items.title: Unity and Google announce AI gaming partnership
items.summary: Unity and Google announced a collaboration combining Google’s AI capabilities with Unity development tools to support natural-language game creation and broader access to game development.

items.title: Ape Escape revival reportedly in development
items.summary: Evening Star, the studio formed by members of the Sonic Mania team, is reportedly working on an Ape Escape revival, though the project is not believed to be close to release.

items.title: Kuwait to host inaugural Asian Esports and Mind Sports Games
items.summary: Kuwait will host the first Asian Esports and Mind Sports Games in 2027, with approximately 4,000 athletes expected to participate.

items.title: Hyundai unveils electric SUV concept in The Crew Motorfest
items.summary: Hyundai revealed its CRATER Concept compact electric off-road SUV inside Ubisoft’s The Crew Motorfest.
